question.text: Mr. Ramesh Iyer, CFO at Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (a Category III AIF structured as an irrevocable determinate trust), is briefing a new analyst on the fund's tax framework. He states that the ITA pass-through framework that applies to Category I and II AIFs does NOT extend to Category III AIFs. Which section is he referring to?

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 115UB read with Sections 10(23FBA) and 10(23FBB) sets out the pass-through (Investment Fund) regime that applies to Category I and II AIFs. The workbook expressly states that no pass-through status has been accorded to Category III AIFs, so this framework does not extend to them. Section 112A deals with LTCG on listed equity, Section 10(38) is the withdrawn LTCG exemption, and Section 80C is an individual deduction. The Trap: Candidates who remember Section 115UB as the generic AIF tax provision can forget that it applies only to Categories I and II. Options B to D are popular ITA sections used as plausible distractors but govern unrelated topics. Note: Because Section 115UB does not apply, a Category III AIF is taxed under general trust-taxation principles at the fund level, with the trustee or fund acting as representative assessee.
